# blob_at { #crossrepo.gitutil.blob_at }

```python
crossrepo.gitutil.blob_at(repo, rev, path)
```

Find the blob sha and size of a file as of a revision.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Union](`typing.Union`)\[[Location](`crossrepo.location.Location`), [Path](`pathlib.Path`), [str](`str`)\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Working tree to inspect, on this machine or another.

<code>[**rev**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Revision to read the file at, typically a commit sha.

<code>[**path**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository-relative path of the file.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Optional](`typing.Optional`)\[[Tuple](`typing.Tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [int](`int`)\]\]]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   ``(blob_sha, size)``, or `None` if the file does not exist at `rev`.
